The '''Heffrin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Heffrin]].

==Behind the scenes==
On page 147 of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', Heffrin is misspelled "Heffirin."
